text:
Friskies, the Purina brand, is the one I recall using the slogan that cats "ask for it by name." The team note places that claim on a premium gourmet line with "Feast" in its title, which I can't confirm and which doesn't match my recollection of Friskies' marketing. I haven't checked current ads, so the Friskies attribution is from memory and the note's attribution is unresolved.

CONFIDENCE: 60
